evidence: The reactants used are diethylzinc Electronic grade from Morton International and deionized Mil-lipore water. The precursor reservoirs are at 22 8C. Pulsing lengths are varied between 20 ms and a few seconds. In the standard operating mode, the pulsing sequence is the following: pulse 1: DEZn for 200 ms pulse 2: N purge for 500 ms pulse 3: H O for 200 ms2 pulse 4: N purge for 500 ms2
